quality.behavior: All nine combinations set LiveKit capture dimensions, max capture frame rate, encoder maximum frame rate and an estimated maximum bitrate. Android defaults to 720p/15 FPS; desktop defaults to 1080p/30 FPS. The selected combination remains active for subsequent shares in the same app session.

implementation.source_picker: Replaces the plain SDK dialog with a responsive dark-themed screen/window picker, live thumbnails, selected state, refresh, empty/error/retry states, Android system-permission guidance and a bandwidth hint.

checks.name: Quality mapping and picker selection
checks.observation: All nine resolution/frame-rate combinations map to the requested capture dimensions and encoding caps; widget test selects 1440p/60 FPS and verifies it is returned to the launch flow.
